---
title: Anguilla
id: MAR-0102
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 45
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 1 small eel, skinned and ready for cooking
- 280 g rice
- 1 l fish stock
- 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
- 10 g butter
- to taste juice of 1 lemon
- 1 tablespoon chopped parsley
- 0.5 onion
## Method
1. Cut the eel into chunks.
2. Heat the oil in a saucepan, add the onion and let it wilt for 5 minutes.
3. Add the eel, stir and let it flavor for 3-4 minutes; moisten it with the lemon juice, then with a little broth, and let it cook for 20 minutes, until tender.
4. In a saucepan, melt the butter and toast the rice for a minute.
5. Pour the remaining boiling broth one ladle at a time, so that the liquid just covers the surface of the rice, and cook until done.
6. Remove the bones from the eel pieces and add the flesh to the rice just before turning off the heat.
7. Finish with the parsley, stir and serve.
